explosionwand.jei.rift_core: Dropped in the chest of the Rift Heart's lair, the last hall of the Rift. Defeat the Heart to get the chest with the Core, the Rift Staff and the Seal Shard: Sleep.
explosionwand.jei.eclipse_heart: Dropped in the loot chest of the Eclipse King. The boss is summoned with the Eclipse Seal, which requires a Rift Core.
explosionwand.jei.dream_staff: Found in the loot chest of the Dream Monolith together with the Dreaming Eye. The Monolith is summoned with the Dreamer's Seal, crafted from an Eclipse Heart.
explosionwand.jei.dreaming_eye: Dropped in the loot chest of the Dream Monolith. Needed for the Sky Seal, which summons the Sky Whale.
explosionwand.jei.whale_staff: Found in the loot chest of the Sky Whale. Summon it with the Sky Seal, which requires a Dreaming Eye.
item.explosionwand.seal_shard_rift.desc: Held in hand, pulls toward the nearest Rift. Trembles and rings nearby. Unlocks its door.
explosionwand.shard.near: The shard trembles and rings: %s is very close
explosionwand.shard.silent: The shard is silent: no trace of the Seal here
explosionwand.dungeon.locked.rift: The crystal door is locked. Unlock it with the Seal Shard: Rift
explosionwand.dungeon.brazier_lit: Brazier lit: you will respawn here
explosionwand.dungeon.building: The walls are still being built here. Wait a moment
explosionwand.dungeon.cleared: Hall complete: a reward chest appeared
explosionwand.dungeon.peaceful: The dungeon sleeps in peaceful mode
explosionwand.dungeon.no_teleport: The dungeon walls refuse you: teleportation does not work
explosionwand.dungeon.no_wand: This wand is silent inside a dungeon
explosionwand.dungeon.solved: The mechanism clicks: a passage has opened somewhere
explosionwand.dungeon.lever: The lever is pulled: something shifts in the wall
explosionwand.dungeon.seal_shut: The door slams shut. There is no way back until the lair falls silent
explosionwand.mob.dreamer_cast: The Dreamweaver lulls you: leave the circle!
explosionwand.mob.cradler_chime: The Cradler swings the lantern: leave the chime range or take cover!
explosionwand.mob.cradler_lantern.sub: The chime is silenced, strike its body
explosionwand.mob.fog_steal: The Fog Walker stole your item: catch it!
explosionwand.mob.fog_escaped: The Fog Walker faded into the mist, leaving your item on the ground
item.explosionwand.rift_staff.desc1: Use: a crack that pulls mobs on its line and hurts them
item.explosionwand.rift_staff.desc2: Shift+Use: step through the rift, 8 blocks ahead
explosionwand.jei.rift_staff: Dropped in the loot chest of the Rift Heart, together with the Rift Core and the Seal Shard: Sleep.
item.explosionwand.sleep_seal_shard.desc: Leads to the nearest City of Sleepers while held. Trembles and rings when close. Unlocks its main gate.
explosionwand.jei.sleep_seal_shard: Dropped in the loot chest of the Rift Heart. Cannot be crafted.
explosionwand.dungeon.locked.sleep: The gate of the City of Sleepers is locked. Unlock it with the Seal Shard: Sleep
explosionwand.rift_staff.no_dungeon: The rift will not open into a dungeon
explosionwand.rift_staff.no_room: The rift leads nowhere: no room ahead
explosionwand.boss.rift.name: Rift Heart
explosionwand.boss.rift.shield.sub: Break the four crystals on the edge of the hall
explosionwand.boss.rift.shield.hint: The Heart is shielded! Break the 4 amethyst crystals on the pillars!
explosionwand.boss.rift.shield.broken: Shield broken! Strike while it is stunned!
explosionwand.boss.rift.rage.sub: Two beams and a ground slam
explosionwand.boss.rift.dead.sub: Loot is in the chest, the door is open
explosionwand.dungeon.locked.sleep_templ: The temple door is locked. Unlock it with the Temple Seal from the crypt
item.explosionwand.temple_seal.desc: Lies in a crypt under one of the houses of the City of Sleepers. Unlocks the temple door in the city centre.
explosionwand.jei.temple_seal: Found in the crypt chest of the City of Sleepers (the house under the moon sign). Cannot be crafted.
explosionwand.city.fog_warn: The fog is thickening. Do not stand still
explosionwand.city.fog_slow: Sleep creeps over you: your legs turn to lead
explosionwand.city.gate_closed: The gate is shut. You cannot enter the city without a Sleep Shard
explosionwand.jei.magic_rod: Crafted from a stick, an amethyst shard and a gold nugget. The base of every wand.
explosionwand.jei.simple_core: Crafted from an amethyst shard, redstone and lapis lazuli. Needed for the starter wands.
explosionwand.jei.crystal_core: Crafted from Rift Dust and an amethyst block. Element core for Rift wands.
explosionwand.jei.wind_core: Crafted from Sleep Thread, feathers and an iron ingot. Element core for Sleeping City wands.
explosionwand.jei.fire_core: Crafted from Ashen Coal, a coal block and flint and steel. Element core for Sanctuary wands.
explosionwand.jei.rift_dust: Dropped by Rift mobs (and Crystal Beetles near a Rift). Common dungeon material.
explosionwand.jei.echo_crystal: Found in chests of the Rift side rooms, halls and lair. Rare dungeon material.
explosionwand.jei.rift_marrow: Found only in chests of the secret Rift rooms. Very rare dungeon material.
explosionwand.jei.sleep_thread: Dropped by Sleeping City mobs (and Fog Walkers). Common dungeon material.
explosionwand.jei.teal_stitch: Found in chests of the Sleeping City houses, library, observatory and crypt. Rare dungeon material.
explosionwand.jei.sleeper_tear: Found only in chests of the Sleeping City's hidden rooms (e.g. the Archmage's Bed). Very rare dungeon material.
explosionwand.jei.ash_coal: Dropped by Ashen Sanctuary mobs. Common dungeon material. The Sanctuary arrives in a later version.
explosionwand.jei.smoldering_feather: Found in chests of the Ashen Sanctuary side rooms. Rare dungeon material. The Sanctuary arrives in a later version.
explosionwand.jei.phoenix_spark: Found in chests of the secret Ashen Sanctuary rooms. Very rare dungeon material. The Sanctuary arrives in a later version.
item.explosionwand.light_wand.desc1: Right-click: hang a glowing wisp in the air for 3 minutes
item.explosionwand.light_wand.desc2: In dungeons it is only a light for mobs, no block; a moth can snuff it
explosionwand.jei.light_wand: Starter wand: rod + Simple Core + glowstone block. A torch replacement: the wisp hangs anywhere within 24 blocks.
item.explosionwand.frost_wand.desc1: Right-click: a cone of cold slows mobs in front of you
item.explosionwand.frost_wand.desc2: Source water under and ahead of you turns to ice for 20 seconds
explosionwand.jei.frost_wand: Starter wand: rod + Simple Core + packed ice. An ice path across a river; leaves water alone near dungeons and in the mod's dimensions.
item.explosionwand.growth_wand.desc1: Right-click: speeds up crops and trees within 5 blocks
item.explosionwand.growth_wand.desc2: Cooldown 5 seconds; does nothing near dungeons
explosionwand.jei.growth_wand: Starter wand: rod + Simple Core + bone block. A sapling usually needs two uses.
item.explosionwand.gather_wand.desc1: Right-click: for 3 seconds pulls items and experience within 10 blocks
explosionwand.jei.gather_wand: Starter wand: rod + Simple Core + hopper.
item.explosionwand.return_wand.desc1: Right-click: 5 second cast, then you return to your bed
item.explosionwand.return_wand.desc2: Moving or taking damage interrupts it; cooldown 10 minutes; silent in dungeons
explosionwand.jei.return_wand: Starter wand: rod + Simple Core + any bed. Needs a bed as your spawn point; does not work in the mod's dimensions.
item.explosionwand.signal_wand.desc1: Right-click: a flare and a column of light at the aimed point, visible from afar
item.explosionwand.signal_wand.desc2: The mark burns for 15 seconds, cooldown 10 seconds
explosionwand.jei.signal_wand: Starter wand: rod + Simple Core + firework rocket. Changes no blocks, works anywhere.
item.explosionwand.digger_wand.desc1: Right-click a block: a 3x3 tunnel 8 blocks deep along your gaze
item.explosionwand.digger_wand.desc2: Cooldown 8 seconds; silent in dungeons; leaves containers and bedrock alone
explosionwand.jei.digger_wand: Expensive: rod + 4 diamonds + Rift Dust. Drops as if mined with a diamond pickaxe. Cooldown gets shorter in later worlds.
item.explosionwand.explosion_wand.desc1: Right-click: a poke like a Power I arrow and a small blast
item.explosionwand.explosion_wand.desc2: Breaks 2-4 blocks near the hit, never dungeon blocks
explosionwand.jei.explosion_wand: Rod + Crystal Core + Echo Crystal + TNT. The orbital strike and embers were removed.
explosionwand.earth.no_room: No room for a wisp here
explosionwand.earth.blocked: Magic does not reshape the land here
explosionwand.earth.return_nobed: No bed: spawn point not set or the bed is gone
item.explosionwand.crystal_spikes_wand.d: Right-click: a line of crystal spikes erupts ahead
5 damage and a launch, once per target per line. Breaks no blocks, works in dungeons too
explosionwand.jei.crystal_spikes_wand: Rod + Crystal Core + Echo Crystal + Rift Marrow (Rift dungeon materials). Breaks no blocks; works in dungeons.
item.explosionwand.stone_skin_wand.desc1: Right-click: 6 seconds of half damage taken
item.explosionwand.stone_skin_wand.desc2: But you are slower (Slowness II). Cooldown 20 seconds
explosionwand.jei.stone_skin_wand: Rod + Crystal Core + Rift Marrow + stone. Works in dungeons.
item.explosionwand.wind_wand.desc1: Right-click: a gust knocks mobs back and swats foreign projectiles
item.explosionwand.wind_wand.desc2: Shift+right-click: launch yourself upward (slow falling). City moths speed up
explosionwand.jei.wind_wand: Rod + Wind Core + Teal Stitch + Sleeper's Tear (Sleeper City materials). Does not push dungeon mobs.
item.explosionwand.vine_wand.desc1: Right-click: vines bind mobs in a circle for 3 seconds
item.explosionwand.vine_wand.desc2: Radius 4 around your aim point; bound mobs cannot move
explosionwand.jei.vine_wand: Rod + Wind Core + vine + Teal Stitch. Does not hold dungeon mobs or bosses.
item.explosionwand.pull_wand.desc1: Right-click: pull the mob, item or XP orb you are looking at
item.explosionwand.pull_wand.desc2: Range 32 blocks; the target is yanked toward you in three pulses
explosionwand.jei.pull_wand: Rod + Wind Core + ender pearl + Teal Stitch. Does not pull dungeon mobs or bosses.
item.explosionwand.decoy_wand.desc1: Right-click: a glass decoy illusion for 5 seconds
item.explosionwand.decoy_wand.desc2: Nearby mobs attack the illusion instead of you. One illusion at a time
explosionwand.jei.decoy_wand: Rod + Wind Core + glass + Sleeper's Tear (Sleeper City materials). The illusion is removed on a timer and when leaving the world.
item.explosionwand.spark_wand.desc1: Right-click: three homing sparks that ignite the target
item.explosionwand.spark_wand.desc2: 4 damage and 4 seconds of fire. They do not ignite blocks
explosionwand.jei.spark_wand: Rod + Fire Core + Smoldering Feather + Phoenix Spark (Ash Sanctuary materials; not dropped anywhere yet).
item.explosionwand.heat_wand.desc1: Right-click: heals you and nearby players and grants regeneration
item.explosionwand.heat_wand.desc2: Radius 8, +4 hearts and Regeneration II for 5 seconds. Tamed pets too
explosionwand.jei.heat_wand: Rod + Fire Core + Smoldering Feather + golden apple (Ash Sanctuary material; not dropped anywhere yet).
explosionwand.earth.no_pull_target: No target on your line of sight (up to 32 blocks)
